correctness.rationale: For n=q h with h odd, CRT in Z4[x] splits the cyclic module into a size 4^(n-q) invertible component and a free rank-q nilpotent component. In the latter y=1+x satisfies y^q=2y^(q/2) and y^(3q/2)=0. Explicit free/2-torsion generators of y^tA give |y^tA|=4^(q-t) through q/2, then 2^(3q/2-t) through 3q/2. Orbit is periodic exactly when the nilpotent coordinate vanishes. Kernel/image cardinalities yield the all-t CDF, whose differences give the exact theorem; y^(3q/2-1)≠0 proves maximality. Tests in verify.py check 69904 initial tuples and 165 circulant image cases.

value.rationale: This classifies every first-cycle-entry depth for every even-length modulo-four Ducci vector, a natural statistic explicitly motivated by the published maximum preperiod problem. The two distinct geometric regimes, exactly-one-half extremal population and universality under odd length multiples are nontrivial global consequences not supplied by a known maximum-time theorem. This is a natural complete classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
